title: Shinzo Host - single
description: Shinzo host: one node in detail.

list.name: chain
list.label: Chain
list.description: Chain name (shinzo.chain.name) of the per-chain host metrics: documents, block signatures, attestations, heights and the attestation queue. Host-wide metrics (peers, views, queries, billing, process) are not filtered.

list.name: network
list.label: Network
list.description: Chain network (shinzo.chain.network) of the per-chain host metrics.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Healthy when the host received documents from peers in the last 10m and has peers > 0 (same checks as the original host dashboard). A running host that has never received a document is Unhealthy. A check whose metric is missing (P2P disabled) is skipped. Down = no data.

targets.expr:
min by (instance) (
  label_replace((sum by (instance) (increase(shinzo_host_documents_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[10m])) or 0 * max by (instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) > bool 0, "check", "receiving", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (instance) (shinzo_p2p_peers{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) > bool 0, "check", "peers", "", "")
)

panels.title: Version
panels.description: service.version, os.type and host.arch from target_info (resource attributes).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: process.uptime of the host process.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Process restarts in the selected time range (resets of process.uptime).

panels.title: Block height
panels.description: Newest block this host attested, per chain.

targets.expr: max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_height{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Lag
panels.description: Blocks between the highest verified peer block signature and the newest attested block, per chain.

targets.expr: max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_received{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) - max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_height{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Unique peers connected to the embedded DefraDB node.

panels.title: Views
panels.description: Views registered on this host.

panels.title: Attestation queue
panels.description: Block signatures waiting in each chain's attestation queue.

targets.expr: max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_queue_documents{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Documents received
panels.description: Documents replicated from peers, all collections of the selected chains.

panels.title: Attestations
panels.description: Successful attestation record writes.

panels.title: Attestation errors
panels.description: Share of attestation record writes that failed.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(shinzo_host_attestations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(shinzo_host_attestations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Queries served
panels.description: GraphQL requests that passed the billing gate (count of shinzo.host.query.duration).

panels.title: Billing rejected
panels.description: Share of billed GraphQL requests that were denied or failed at the billing gate.

panels.title: Errors per minute
panels.description: Every error signal the host exports: failed signature verifications, signatures dropped from a full queue, failed attestation writes, billing gate errors by reason, failed service records, failed view registrations.

panels.title: Replicated documents by chain and collection
panels.description: Documents received from peers, by chain and collection. Local writes are not counted.

targets.expr: sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network, collection) (rate(shinzo_host_documents_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

panels.title: Documents in range by chain and collection
panels.description: Documents received from peers during the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network, collection) (increase(shinzo_host_documents_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Block height
panels.description: Newest attested block vs the highest block number in a verified peer block signature, per chain.

targets.expr: max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_received{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})
max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_height{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: Blocks between the highest verified peer block signature and the newest attested block, per chain.

targets.expr: max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_received{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) - max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_block_height{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Attestation queue
panels.description: Block signatures waiting in each chain's attestation queue.

targets.expr: max by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (shinzo_host_queue_documents{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Connected peers
panels.description: Unique peers connected to the embedded DefraDB node.

panels.title: Block height growth
panels.description: Attested blocks per minute (derivative of shinzo.host.block.height) vs received blocks per minute, per chain.

panels.title: Block signatures
panels.description: Peer block signatures by chain and verification result, and signatures dropped because the chain's attestation queue was full.

targets.expr: sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network, result) (rate(shinzo_host_block_signatures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

panels.title: Attestation writes
panels.description: Attestation record writes by result. Pruned records and cancellations are not counted.

targets.expr: sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network, result) (rate(shinzo_host_attestations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

panels.title: Attestation write duration
panels.description: Attestation record write latency percentiles (all results).

panels.title: Attestation write duration heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of attestation record write latency.

panels.title: Attestation write p95 by chain and result
panels.description: p95 write latency split by result: slow failures usually mean transaction conflicts or retries.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network, result) (rate(shinzo_host_attestation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Attestation error ratio
panels.description: Share of attestation record writes that failed.

targets.expr: (sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (rate(shinzo_host_attestations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (rate(shinzo_host_attestations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (rate(shinzo_host_attestations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Signature verification failure ratio
panels.description: Share of peer block signatures that failed verification.

targets.expr: (sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (rate(shinzo_host_block_signatures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (rate(shinzo_host_block_signatures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network", result!="unlisted"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (rate(shinzo_host_block_signatures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network", result!="unlisted"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Billing gate decisions
panels.description: Billed GraphQL requests at the gate: allowed, denied by reason, failed by reason.

panels.title: Service records
panels.description: Service records submitted to the accounting service, by result.

panels.title: Query duration
panels.description: Latency of serving GraphQL requests that passed the billing gate.

panels.title: Query duration heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of GraphQL serving latency (requests past the billing gate).

panels.title: Queries served
panels.description: GraphQL requests that passed the billing gate and were served.

panels.title: Billing decision mix
panels.description: Share of billed requests by gate result (allow / deny / error).

panels.title: Rejections in range by reason
panels.description: Denied and failed billed requests during the selected time range, by result and reason.

panels.title: Registered views
panels.description: Views registered on this host.

panels.title: View registrations
panels.description: View registrations by result.

panels.title: DHT messages
panels.description: Kademlia DHT messages received and sent, by message type. Exported by go-libp2p-kad-dht (used by DefraDB's go-p2p) through the host's global meter provider; WAN and LAN DHTs are summed.

panels.title: DHT outbound requests
panels.description: Kademlia DHT requests sent, by message type. Exported by go-libp2p-kad-dht (used by DefraDB's go-p2p) through the host's global meter provider; WAN and LAN DHTs are summed.

panels.title: DHT errors
panels.description: Kademlia DHT message and request errors. Exported by go-libp2p-kad-dht (used by DefraDB's go-p2p) through the host's global meter provider; WAN and LAN DHTs are summed.

panels.title: DHT request latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 latency of handling inbound and sending outbound DHT requests. Exported by go-libp2p-kad-dht (used by DefraDB's go-p2p) through the host's global meter provider; WAN and LAN DHTs are summed.

panels.title: DHT network size estimate
panels.description: Network size estimated by the DHT during lookups. Exported by go-libp2p-kad-dht (used by DefraDB's go-p2p) through the host's global meter provider; WAN and LAN DHTs are summed.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: process.uptime; a drop to 0 is a restart. The host exports no Go runtime metrics.
